table extension_map
  column ext | text | NOT NULL |  |  |

  constraint extension_map_category_id_fkey | FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(id)

  constraint extension_map_pkey | PRIMARY KEY (ext)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX extension_map_pkey ON public.extension_map USING btree (ext)

  column id | bigint | NOT NULL | nextval('scan_errors_id_seq'::regclass) |  |

  constraint scan_errors_pkey | PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint scan_errors_scan_id_fkey | FOREIGN KEY (scan_id) REFERENCES scans(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  index CREATE INDEX scan_errors_scan_idx ON public.scan_errors USING btree (scan_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scan_errors_pkey ON public.scan_errors USING btree (id)
table scans
  column id | bigint | NOT NULL | nextval('scans_id_seq'::regclass) |  |
  column share_id | bigint | NOT NULL |  |  |
  column status | text | NOT NULL | 'running'::text |  |
  column mode | text | NOT NULL |  |  |
  column trigger | text | NOT NULL | 'manual'::text |  |
  column started_at | timestamp with time zone | NOT NULL | now() |  |
  column finished_at | timestamp with time zone | NULL |  |  |
  column excludes_hash | text | NOT NULL | ''::text |  |
  column dirs | bigint | NOT NULL | 0 |  |
  column reused_dirs | bigint | NOT NULL | 0 |  |
  column files | bigint | NOT NULL | 0 |  |
  column bytes | bigint | NOT NULL | 0 |  |
  column alloc_bytes | bigint | NOT NULL | 0 |  |
  column error_count | bigint | NOT NULL | 0 |  |
  column atime_quality | jsonb | NULL |  |  |
  column error | text | NULL |  |  |
  column fs_total_bytes | bigint | NULL |  |  |
  column fs_free_bytes | bigint | NULL |  |  |
  constraint scans_mode_check | CHECK ((mode = ANY (ARRAY['full'::text, 'incremental'::text])))
  constraint scans_pkey | PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint scans_share_id_fkey | FOREIGN KEY (share_id) REFERENCES shares(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint scans_status_check | CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['running'::text, 'succeeded'::text, 'failed'::text, 'cancelled'::text])))
  index CREATE INDEX scans_share_started_idx ON public.scans USING btree (share_id, started_at DESC)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scans_one_running_idx ON public.scans USING btree (share_id) WHERE (status = 'running'::text)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scans_pkey ON public.scans USING btree (id)

table shares
  column id | bigint | NOT NULL | nextval('shares_id_seq'::regclass) |  |
  column name | text | NOT NULL |  |  |
  column kind | text | NOT NULL |  |  |
  column config | jsonb | NOT NULL | '{}'::jsonb |  |
  column excludes | text[] | NOT NULL | '{}'::text[] |  |
  column workers | integer | NOT NULL | 16 |  |
  column max_ops_per_sec | integer | NOT NULL | 0 |  |
  column last_used_basis | text | NOT NULL | 'atime'::text |  |
  column last_scan_id | bigint | NULL |  |  |
  column created_at | timestamp with time zone | NOT NULL | now() |  |
  constraint shares_kind_check | CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['bind'::text, 'nfs'::text, 'smb'::text])))
  constraint shares_last_used_basis_check | CHECK ((last_used_basis = ANY (ARRAY['atime'::text, 'mtime'::text, 'max'::text])))
  constraint shares_max_ops_per_sec_check | CHECK ((max_ops_per_sec >= 0))
  constraint shares_name_key | UNIQUE (name)
  constraint shares_pkey | PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint shares_workers_check | CHECK (((workers >= 1) AND (workers <= 256)))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX shares_name_key ON public.shares USING btree (name)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX shares_pkey ON public.shares USING btree (id)
function
  CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.drop_share_partitions(p_share bigint)
   RETURNS void
   LANGUAGE plpgsql
  AS $function$
  DECLARE t text;
  BEGIN
      FOREACH t IN ARRAY ARRAY['dirs', 'files', 'dir_category_agg', 'share_ext_agg'] LOOP
          EXECUTE format('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS %I', t || '_s' || p_share);
      END LOOP;
  END $function$
function
  CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ensure_share_partitions(p_share bigint)
   RETURNS void
   LANGUAGE plpgsql
  AS $function$
  DECLARE t text;
  BEGIN
      FOREACH t IN ARRAY ARRAY['dirs', 'files', 'dir_category_agg', 'share_ext_agg'] LOOP
          EXECUTE format('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS %I PARTITION OF %I FOR VALUES IN (%s)',
                         t || '_s' || p_share, t, p_share);
      END LOOP;
  END $function$
